scope: Independent source review of phone-review changes before final exclusive build
reviewed_invariants: Native branch adoption requires matching kind and character/group owner, direct-parent sessionName equal to main_chat, nonempty integrity, and a different target chat. Ordinary import remains context strict.

Native branch adoption validates imported archive, reconciles only the retained branch messages, increments revision, and persists through captured target metadata storage. Parent archive is not mutated.
Prepared parent requests stop branch adoption explicitly and retain copied bytes rather than silently reset or invent completion.
Rejected phone replies are keyed by stable message UID plus exact candidate hash; rejection is limited to the active bound turn, actual last selected assistant source, and no existing accepted frame.
Metadata/storage failure after valid parsing is not flagged phoneReplyInvalid, so it cannot be silently classified as a malformed reply.
Rejected source records preserve original reason and request; historical enumeration skips only that exact rejected candidate. Corrected text hashes and regenerated candidates remain eligible.
Snapshots for rejected sources raise PHONE_SOURCE_REJECTED; the failure is visible rather than replaced with current/live data.

limitations: Source review and automated native adapters are not installed-host or Android acceptance.
A native branch copied while a parent request is still prepared is explicitly rejected; recovery instructions require resolving the parent and creating a fresh branch.
